description: GENERAL graph-native discrimination: score how well a Sense's labelled Exemplars (each with an L2-normalised `feat` vector laid by the world) separate by label. (mean between-label - mean within-label squared distance)/(between+within); distance via the Rust Dot Term. No Python measurement — the world lays the features (affordance), the GRAPH scores them.

microtheory.name: feature_discrimination
microtheory.description: between-within over labelled feature vectors; a Rust DSL fold.

rules.name: keep_discriminative_cue
rules.comment: GRAPH-NATIVE cue selection (effect-gate). A CueGate probes one CueProbe per cue (each has_exemplar that cue's labelled responses, laid by the world). KEEP a cue whose per-cue label discrimination exceeds the mean across the gate's probes. The discrimination is the feature_discrimination fold; the KEEP is this Rule (Rust).
